From: Anya Reddy <anya.reddy@medplus.com>

Cc: procurement@medplus.com, sec-qa@medplus.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial procurement evidence request for Redwood (next steps & PO)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for your time on the call earlier. Per MedPlus procurement policy, before we can generate a PO and add a commercial contract to our system we need a short packet of evidence:

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
- ISO 27001 certificate (if available)
- Summary of most recent external penetration test (high-level findings; redacted PII OK)
- Completed vendor onboarding questionnaire (we prefer XLSX)

Can you confirm these are available and share an expected delivery date? Also note our PO flow has a 7–10 business day lead time after receiving the package and signed SOW. If there are any procurement exceptions (redlines, SSO/KMS questions), please flag them now so we can route to legal.

Team here: Anya Reddy (procurement lead) & MedPlus security ops (sec-qa@medplus.com).

Thanks — we want to get this moving this week.

Best,
Anya Reddy
Head of Procurement
MedPlus Health

[Attachment: MedPlus_Vendor_Onboarding_Template.xlsx]

Anya — thanks for the clear list. We can provide all four items. High-level plan:

- SOC 2 Type II (redacted): I will attach our 2025 report by EOD Friday (Jun 12).
- ISO27001 certificate: we have a copy (issued 2024) and can provide a scan.
- Pen test summary: security will prepare a 1‑page summary of findings; redacted.
- Questionnaire: we will fill the MedPlus template and return as XLSX.

Michael will lead the evidence bundle and Marissa will handle the questionnaire/PO contact. Vivek is looped for anything legal/procurement exceptions.

Can you confirm the preferred secure upload method? We can share via a pre-authenticated GDrive link or SFTP depending on MedPlus policy.

Thanks,

Thanks Michael — received and we started intake review. A couple of quick clarifications from our security team:

1) In the SOC2 report there are redactions around configuration management. Can you provide a short note confirming the control owner and whether that control is tested by a subservice org?
2) For the pen test summary, can you confirm whether any findings were classified as critical or high and whether remediation is complete?

You can reply on-thread or drop the clarifications into the questionnaire (column "Security follow-ups"). We want to avoid an extended back-and-forth since our PO timing depends on a clean intake.

Thanks — Sec Ops
MedPlus Health
